meta.name: li-comment
meta.description: Write comments on other people's LinkedIn posts that read as a person with an opinion, not a bot. Use when the user pastes a post and wants a comment, says "comment on this", "engage with this", "what do I say here", or wants a batch of comments for their engagement round.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把别人的领英帖子写成一段有观点、像真人写的评论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想在领英参与讨论却不知道开口说什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a LinkedIn post into a comment that sounds like a real person with a view
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to join LinkedIn conversations but don't know what to say.

howto.what: 你贴入别人的 LinkedIn 帖子后,它按九种评论类型给出两条不同类型的评论选项,标注类型,并说明推荐发哪条。它只负责写,不会替你发布。
howto.when: 当你贴入一条 LinkedIn 帖子、说“comment on this”等要求评论,或要做一轮批量互动(5-10 条帖子)时接管。

say.text: 帮我评这条 LinkedIn 帖子:[贴入文本]
say.note: 给两条不同类型选项并说明推荐哪条

say.text: 换一种评论类型,再来一条
say.note: 从九种类型里换一类重写

say.text: 这周要互动,这是 5 条帖子:[贴入文本]
say.note: 每条各给一条评论,并记录已评过谁

howto.what_en: After you paste someone's LinkedIn post, it writes two labeled comment options of different types, each 2-4 sentences, plus a one-line reason for the one to post. It only writes the comment; you publish it yourself.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you paste a post and ask for a comment, say things like "comment on this", or ask for a batch of comments for an engagement round of 5-10 posts.

say_en.text: Write a comment on this LinkedIn post: [paste text]
say_en.note: You get two labeled comment options plus a recommendation.

say_en.text: Give me another option as a different comment type
say_en.note: Rewrites the comment using another of the nine types.

say_en.text: I'm doing an engagement round - here are 5 posts: [paste]
say_en.note: One comment per post, plus a log of who you've commented on.
